definitions.explanation: The act of photographing or filming something again, typically because the first attempt was unsatisfactory. Used in photography, film production, and document processing.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}がぼやけていたので{再撮影|さいさつえい}した。
examples.english: The photo was blurry, so I retook it.

examples.japanese: パスポートの{写真|しゃしん}が{基準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たさず、{再撮影|さいさつえい}を{求|もと}められた。
examples.english: My passport photo didn't meet the requirements, and I was asked to retake it.

examples.japanese: {監督|かんとく}は{演技|えんぎ}に{納得|なっとく}がいかず、{何度|なんど}も{再撮影|さいさつえい}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The director wasn't satisfied with the acting and repeated the retake many times.

notes:
Composed of {再|さい} (re-, again) and {撮影|さつえい} (photography, filming). The prefix {再|さい} is highly productive: {再確認|さいかくにん} (reconfirmation), {再検討|さいけんとう} (reconsideration), {再発行|さいはっこう} (reissuance). This word applies to both still photography and video/film production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再撮影|さいさつえい}する: to retake/reshoot
- {再撮影|さいさつえい}を{依頼|いらい}する: to request a retake
- {再撮影|さいさつえい}が{必要|ひつよう}: a retake is needed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {撮|と}り{直|なお}し: retake — the native Japanese equivalent, more colloquial and commonly used in everyday conversation
- リテイク: retake — the English loanword, often used in film and TV production
- {再録|さいろく}: re-recording — for audio or video recording rather than photography
